description: This source file defines the internal class 'GrainFactory' within the Orleans framework, providing methods for accessing grains, creating object references, and managing grain identities and types. It implements 'IInternalGrainFactory' and includes functionalities such as obtaining grains by various keys, casting grains, and managing system targets.

classes.name: GrainFactory
classes.description: An internal class responsible for creating and managing grain references, system targets, and object references within the Orleans framework.

methods.name: GetGrain
methods.description: Retrieves a grain reference based on provided key types (Guid, long, string).

methods.name: CreateObjectReference
methods.description: Creates a grain observer object reference or general object reference.

methods.name: DeleteObjectReference
methods.description: Deletes an object reference for a grain observer.

methods.name: Cast
methods.description: Casts a grain to a specific interface type.

methods.name: GetSystemTarget
methods.description: Retrieves a system target by grain type and address or by grain ID.
